A '''setla lamp''' was a sleek lighting device found in many apartments. Its indirect lighting made it very pleasant to the eye, and [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] kept a setla lamp in his [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] apartment.
